This site suggests a few steps for getting featured in Google AI Overviews:

- **Answer specific questions thoroughly.** Google's AI systems favor content that covers the core question and related subtopics in depth, offers insights not easily found elsewhere, and is kept up to date [6].
- **Be patient.** There's no guaranteed timeframe, but websites typically need 2-3 months of consistent optimization before they appear in AI Overviews [1].

questions.answer: A GEO strategy needs technical SEO as its base. Without it, AI systems may be unable to crawl or index your content, and unstructured or slow pages may be passed over [2]. The essentials include making sure AI crawlers can reach your pages, that important content renders in the HTML, and that pages are indexed [3]. Joe's AEO program also covers AI crawler rules, server-rendered content, llms.txt, page speed, and schema markup such as organization, person, and service schema [4]. Fast loading, mobile optimization, and clean site architecture are also treated as GEO essentials [7]. For more on working with Joe, see [the contact page](/contact/).
